answer: Staking collateral C and slashing S=κC (κ>1) make each Sybil clone a net capital loss, so the protocol is not a haven for free identity multiplication. Non-refundable attestation fees f plus compounding opportunity cost r yield MC(n)=C(1+r)^n+f, an escalating cost curve that turns an oasis of cheap sybils into an economically untenable expansion. Zero-knowledge verifiable delay Δ bounds attestation latency, yielding U=pR−[C+κC+f]<0 and a robust Nash equilibrium where honest attestation dominates, denying adversaries any safe harbor for profitable deviation.
